notes: Native TensorFold arm with DFlash2 drafting (operator decision 2026-10-31; ADR-063 D2 arm T2): TensorFold 1157ea5b (version 1.2.0) serving its own MLX 4-bit checkpoint TensorFold/Qwen3.8-27B-MLX-4bit@22d8d538 with the stock DFlash2 drafter z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2@50307d4c (5 layers, 2048 sliding window, zig/src/families/qwen27/dflash/config.zig:61; 1.92 B bf16 parameters, loaded 4-bit). It is NOT the hf2q GGUF and NOT the same-GGUF peer. In Q3 it runs only as the separately labeled peer arm 'TensorFold 1157ea5 + DFlash2 (native Qwen3.8-27B MLX 4-bit)' of a --native-comparison campaign: task makespan only, never the verdict of record. native-tensorfold-qwen38.json is the no-drafter arm; this argv adds only '--drafter {DRAFTER_DIR} --drafter-bits 4'.

DFlash2 at four streams: every live stream drafts its own tree in batched drafter passes of up to TF_Q27_DRAFT_SLOTS (default 8) streams (native/qwen27_drafts.zig:26-80; README.md:214), shared trees capped at 15 or 31 nodes (native/qwen27_window.zig). The startup line 'Qwen3.8-27B: 4 streams of 262144 tokens, DFlash2 drafts for one of them' (native/qwen27_served.zig:407) is the drafter-loaded proof, but its wording is wrong: all streams draft. --drafter-bits 4 is the CLI default made explicit (server/cli.zig:222; native/metal.zig:362). Drafted output must equal the plain decode on this engine and checkpoint (README.md:203-207). Every reply's speculative {rounds, drafted, accepted} and the server's done line are recorded by native_peer_tensorfold_audit; the run must draft at least once.

Flags (zig/src/server/cli.zig:41-155; TensorFold source at /opt/TensorFold): the snapshot directory is served directly, so no hub lookup runs and /v1/benchmark/manifest attests model.revision from the snapshots/<sha> directory name (server/benchmark_manifest.zig:190-196; TF_CHECKPOINT_REVISION must agree or the revision is dropped). --context 262144 is the per-request prompt-plus-reply bound and the model's maximum (native/metal.zig:357-361); each slot is sized at context plus the verify window (native/qwen27_served.zig:332,355). --parallel 4 is a fixed lane count: if four slots do not fit beside the weights and an 8 GiB margin, startup refuses with '--parallel 4 needs X GiB ... lower --parallel or --context' (qwen27_served.zig:336-338) instead of shrinking ('auto' would shrink). --temperature 0 is greedy (server.zig:252-264). --max-tokens 8192 is the default reply limit (requests send max_completion_tokens 8192). --keep-warm 900 is the default made explicit (README.md:297). --no-update-check, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, TENSORFOLD_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 and TENSORFOLD_NO_LIVE=1 are TensorFold's own benchmark child environment (server/benchmark_server.zig:50-56): no network, no live status line. No drafter: Qwen3.8-27B 'decodes plain without one' (README.md:294; docs/recipes/qwen3.8-27b.md:3-5).

Settings kept at hf2q-equivalent semantics; the client binds the server argv (ps) to exactly these flags. Prompt cache stays on at its default auto budget (no --prompt-cache-gib; at most 16 GiB of what 70% of RAM leaves, native/cache_fit.zig:14,94-125), because hf2q reuses prefix KV across turns; slot-0 resume stays on (TF_QWEN27_SLOT_RESUME unset). The budget is parsed from the startup log ('prompt cache: X GiB ...') into native_readiness.startup.prompt_cache; at 4 x 262144 it is likely 0 GiB (no room left), which also turns warm turns off. No --learn, --recall, --idle-unload, --loop-guard, --thinking-budget/--reasoning-effort/--no-thinking (each request decides), --kv-cache fp8 or --prompt-precision int8. q5_case.child_env passes only PATH/HOME/USER/... plus this env, so no TF_* tuning variable leaks in.

Memory: weights about 15 GiB plus four 262144-token bf16 KV slots (16 attention layers x 2 x 262160 x 1024 x 2 B, about 16 GiB each), attention scratch (512 prompt rows; about 6 GiB on M5, up to about 16 GiB on M1-M4) and an 8 GiB margin: about 96-106 GiB against Metal's maxWorkingSet (qwen27_served.zig:182-191). A 128 GB Mac's default working set may refuse it unless iogpu.wired_limit_mb is raised (docs/recipes/qwen3.8-27b.md:304). Slots past the first take memory on first use; a slot that does not fit waits ('a slot needs X GiB ... the request waits', qwen27_served.zig:192-200), which the post-run audit counts. The startup reserve line (qwen27_served.zig:345) and /health memory at readiness and after the run are recorded.

Identity: TF_BIN_SHA256 (the root's build of 1157ea5b; the binary embeds only its version, build.zig:74-79) and TARGET_CONFIG_SHA256 (sha256 of the snapshot config.json, TensorFold's own config_sha256) are required inputs; the drafter snapshot (DRAFTER_DIR) is listed and frozen with the campaign identity. The client recomputes config_sha256 and tokenizer_sha256 (benchmark_model.zig:14,160-189; chat_template.jinja included) from the local snapshot and requires the manifest to equal them; the snapshot chat_template.jinja must be the hf2q Qwen3.8 template bytes (sha256 c3cf9e34..., git blob c0c686f9). Readiness also requires /health max_batch_size 4, version 1.2.0, backend metal, /v1/models context_length 262144 with thinking on and no server effort, and the startup lines 'serving qwen3.8-27b ... (sampling: greedy; drafts: DFlash2 (...); context: 262144 ...)' and 'Qwen3.8-27B: 4 streams of 262144 tokens, DFlash2 drafts for one of them', with the serving line's drafts naming 'DFlash2 ({DRAFTER_DIR})'.
Run as a calibration (no --admission-receipt): different binary and artifact from every hf2q calibration.
